title: WabbleSpec Specify Receipt Extension
description: Extension fields for specify-receipt.json. Extends receipt.base.schema.json. All fields required on new receipts.

criteria_count.description: Total acceptance criteria written. Must be at least 1.

gwt_violations.description: Criteria that do not satisfy GWT or EARS format. Target is 0. Receipt is PARTIAL when non-zero.

open_questions_resolved.description: All open questions from scope.md and user intent have been resolved. Must be true before receipt is PASS.

delta_class.description: Classification of the change this spec introduces. Determines Migrate activation and Archive version bump. BREAKING: removes or incompatibly changes existing behavior. ADDITIVE: new capability alongside existing behavior. COSMETIC: no behavior change.

change_summary.description: One-line descriptions of each change. Required when delta_class is BREAKING. Optional for ADDITIVE/COSMETIC. Each item prefixed with its class: 'BREAKING: ...', 'ADDITIVE: ...', 'COSMETIC: ...'.

affected_specs.description: Paths to existing spec artifacts or capability areas affected by this change. Required when delta_class is BREAKING — used by Migrate and Provenance cascade. Empty array for net-new capabilities.

$comment: Migrate activation gate: delta_class == BREAKING triggers Migrate module. Archive version bump: BREAKING -> major, ADDITIVE -> minor, COSMETIC -> patch. Provenance cascade: affected_specs are marked NEEDS_REVERIFICATION when delta_class is BREAKING (Item 016).
